tools.name: create_order
tools.description: 创建订单并返回支付链接。订单金额的 currency 只能是 USD。cart_mandate 的具体 JSON 见该参数说明：method_data 每一项是一种支付方式；附加费写在 details.modifiers，公式是 details.total + additional_display_items 合计 = modifier.total。被 method_data_indexes 选中的方式按 modifier.total 收费，未选中的仍按 details.total。不要把组织 base_fee 写进购物车，也不要传 merchant_authorization。建单前逐项向用户确认，一次只问一项，等用户回复后再问下一项。先确认 merchant_name，再确认 pay_to。不要代填，不要两项一起问。客户端能逐项弹窗时用弹窗，否则在对话里询问。两项都得到明确回复后，再调用本工具并原样传入。服务端不弹窗。传入的 pay_to 覆盖每一项 data.pay_to。付款地址（eip3009 的 from、permit2 的 owner、JWT 的 iss）必须是用户登录钱包的地址，向用户展示并确认后才能使用。不得把 pay_to 或说明中的任何地址默认当作付款地址。建单成功后，签名前必须用 flow_id 调用 get_order。不要传商户私钥或 API secret。 / Create an order and return the payment link. Every amount currency must be USD. The concrete cart_mandate JSON is on that parameter. Each method_data item is one payment method. Surcharges go in details.modifiers. The formula is details.total plus the sum of additional_display_items equals modifier.total. A method selected by method_data_indexes is charged modifier.total. An unselected method stays at details.total. Do not put the organization base_fee in the cart, and do not send merchant_authorization. Before calling this tool, confirm one field at a time and wait for the user's reply before asking the next. Confirm merchant_name first, then pay_to. Do not fill them in and do not ask both at once. Use a per-field dialog when the client can show one; otherwise ask in the conversation. Call this tool only after both replies, and pass them unchanged. This server does not open a form. The pay_to argument overwrites every data.pay_to. The payer address, used as eip3009 from, permit2 owner, and the JWT iss, must be the user's logged-in wallet. Show it and wait for confirmation. Do not default the payer address to pay_to or to any address in these instructions. After the order is created, call get_order with flow_id before signing. Do not send the merchant private key or API secret.

merchant_name.description: 商户名称。先单独向用户确认这一项，等回复后再问收款地址。不要代填，原样传入，用于归属交易所属参赛队伍。 / Merchant name. Confirm this field alone and wait for the reply before asking for the recipient. Do not fill it in. Pass the reply unchanged. It attributes the payment to that team.

pay_to.description: 收款地址。商户名称确认后，再单独向用户确认这一项并等待回复。必须是 0x 开头的 42 位地址。不要填付款地址，不要代填。服务端把它写入每一项 data.pay_to。 / Recipient address. After the merchant name is confirmed, confirm this field alone and wait for the reply. It must be a 42-character 0x address. Do not enter the payer address and do not fill it in. The server writes it to every data.pay_to.

cart_mandate.description: CartMandate 对象，不要传 merchant_authorization。所有 amount.currency 只能是 USD。服务端覆盖 contents.merchant_name 并签署 merchant_authorization。details.id 会成为 payment_request_id，同一商户不可重复。contents.id 是订单 ID。cart_expiry 是 RFC3339。method_data 至少一项，每一项一种支付方式，网络、chain_id、contract_address、coin 必须来自 get_chain_config 的已启用代币。收款地址使用单独的 pay_to 参数。用户逐项确认后传入，服务端写入每一项 data.pay_to，覆盖购物车里的地址。付款地址同样必须由用户确认，不得把 pay_to 或本说明中的地址默认当作付款地址。示例里的 chain_id 0、网络名和尖括号占位符都不是真实值，不得原样提交。网络、chain_id、contract_address、coin 只能来自本次 get_chain_config。supported_methods 固定 https://www.x402.org/，data.x402Version 固定 2。display_items 可空；非空时各项之和必须等于 details.total。附加费不要改 details.total，写进 modifiers。每个 modifier 的 additional_display_items 不能为空。有附加费时必须提供 modifier.total，且 details.total + additional_display_items 之和 = modifier.total。modifier.supported_methods 与被选中的 method_data 相同。data.method_data_indexes 是从 0 开始的 method_data 下标，可多选但不可重复、不可越界；省略时匹配全部相同 supported_methods 的 method_data。同一个 method_data 下标只能属于一个 modifier。选中的方式按 modifier.total 收费，未选中的按 details.total。示例：商品 5.00 USD，只给 method_data[0] 加 1.00 USD 附加费，该方式实付 6.00 USD，method_data[1] 仍付 5.00 USD。{"contents":{"id":"ORDER-1","user_cart_confirmation_required":true,"cart_expiry":"2026-10-27T15:00:00Z","payment_request":{"method_data":[{"supported_methods":"https://www.x402.org/","data":{"x402Version":2,"network":"<已启用网络>","chain_id":0,"contract_address":"<get_chain_config 中该代币 address>","pay_to":"<用户填写并确认的收款地址>","coin":"<符号>"}},{"supported_methods":"https://www.x402.org/","data":{"x402Version":2,"network":"<另一已启用网络>","chain_id":0,"contract_address":"<该代币合约>","pay_to":"<用户填写并确认的收款地址>","coin":"<符号>"}}],"details":{"id":"PAY-1","display_items":[{"label":"商品","amount":{"currency":"USD","value":"5.00"}}],"total":{"label":"合计","amount":{"currency":"USD","value":"5.00"}},"modifiers":[{"supported_methods":"https://www.x402.org/","total":{"label":"含附加费","amount":{"currency":"USD","value":"6.00"}},"additional_display_items":[{"label":"附加费","amount":{"currency":"USD","value":"1.00"}}],"data":{"method_data_indexes":[0]}}]}}}} / CartMandate object. Do not send merchant_authorization. Every amount.currency must be USD. The server overwrites contents.merchant_name and signs merchant_authorization. details.id becomes payment_request_id and must be unique for the merchant. contents.id is the order ID. cart_expiry is RFC3339. method_data has one item per payment method. network, chain_id, contract_address, and coin must come from an enabled token in get_chain_config. The recipient is the separate pay_to argument. Pass it after the user confirms it on its own. The server writes it to every data.pay_to and replaces any address in the cart. The payer address must also be confirmed by the user. Do not default it to pay_to or to any address in this description. chain_id 0, the network names, and angle-bracket placeholders in the example are not real values. Do not submit them unchanged. network, chain_id, contract_address, and coin must come from this get_chain_config response. supported_methods is https://www.x402.org/ and data.x402Version is 2. display_items may be empty. When present, their sum must equal details.total. Put a surcharge in modifiers instead of changing details.total. Each modifier needs non-empty additional_display_items. A surcharge must set modifier.total, and details.total plus the sum of additional_display_items must equal modifier.total. modifier.supported_methods must match the selected method_data. data.method_data_indexes holds zero-based method_data indexes. They may select several indexes, but duplicates and out-of-range indexes are rejected. Omit it to match every method_data with the same supported_methods. Each method_data index can belong to only one modifier. Selected methods charge modifier.total. Unselected methods charge details.total. Example: a 5.00 USD product plus a 1.00 USD surcharge on method_data[0] makes that method 6.00 USD, while method_data[1] stays 5.00 USD. The JSON shape is contents.id, contents.cart_expiry, contents.payment_request.method_data[], and contents.payment_request.details with display_items, total, and modifiers[].additional_display_items plus modifiers[].data.method_data_indexes.

redirect_url.description: 可选的支付完成跳转地址。 / Optional redirect URL after payment.

tools.name: estimate_fee
tools.description: 查询锁价。先调用 get_order 和 get_chain_config。payment_payload 是标准 base64 编码的 x402 v2 JSON，询价时 signature 可留空。JSON 结构：x402Version=2；accepted.scheme=exact；accepted.network=eip155:<method_data.chain_id>；accepted.asset=method_data.contract_address；accepted.payTo=method_data.pay_to；accepted.amount 询价时可填 0；accepted.extra.protocol 取代币的 payment_protocol（eip3009 或 permit2）。eip3009 的 payload.authorization 含 from、to、value、validAfter、validBefore、nonce，其中 to 等于用户已确认的 payTo，from 必须是用户已确认的付款地址，不得默认等于 payTo，也不得照抄说明中的地址。permit2 的 payload.authorization 含 owner、spender、nonce、deadline、permitted.token、permitted.amount，spender 只能取本次 get_chain_config 该代币的 permit2_spender，不得用 Permit2 verifyingContract、pay_to 或付款地址代替。permitted.token 等于 contract_address，owner 必须是用户已确认的付款地址。签名前向用户展示收款地址、付款地址和 token_total_raw，用户明确确认前不要签名。代币合约和 spender 用本次 get_chain_config 核对，不要让用户手填。锁价返回后，把 authorization 的 value 或 permitted.amount 改成 token_total_raw 再签名，禁止本地重算。锁价自本次成功起 5 分钟内有效，截止时间是 quote_expires_at。快照按 payment_request_id、chain_id、asset、payTo 保存。超过该时间再 submit_payment，或提交的 network、asset、payTo 与这次锁价不一致，Gateway 返回 code 30043 quote validation failed。此时必须重新调用 estimate_fee，并用新的 token_total_raw 重新签名。再次锁价会覆盖同一组合的旧快照，旧签名额不能再提交。authorization.validBefore 是链上授权窗口，和这 5 分钟锁价互相独立，提交时两者都要未过期。merchant_name 必须是用户已手动确认的商户名称。 / Lock a quote. Call get_order and get_chain_config first. payment_payload is a standard-base64 x402 v2 JSON object. signature may be empty for the quote. JSON shape: x402Version=2; accepted.scheme=exact; accepted.network=eip155:<method_data.chain_id>; accepted.asset=method_data.contract_address; accepted.payTo=method_data.pay_to; accepted.amount may be 0 for the quote; accepted.extra.protocol is the token payment_protocol (eip3009 or permit2). For eip3009, payload.authorization has from, to, value, validAfter, validBefore, and nonce, to equals the user-confirmed payTo, and from must be the user-confirmed payer address. Do not default from to payTo or copy an address from these instructions. For permit2, payload.authorization has owner, spender, nonce, deadline, permitted.token, and permitted.amount; spender must be that token permit2_spender from this get_chain_config response. Do not substitute the Permit2 verifyingContract, pay_to, or the payer address. permitted.token equals contract_address, and owner must be the user-confirmed payer address. Before signing, show the user the recipient, payer, and token_total_raw. Do not sign before explicit confirmation. Check the token contract and spender against this get_chain_config response. Do not ask the user to type them. After the quote, set value or permitted.amount to token_total_raw and then sign. Do not recompute it. The lock lasts 5 minutes from this successful call. quote_expires_at is the deadline. The snapshot is stored by payment_request_id, chain_id, asset, and payTo. submit_payment after that time, or with a different network, asset, or payTo, returns gateway code 30043 quote validation failed. Call estimate_fee again and sign the new token_total_raw. A new quote replaces the previous snapshot for the same selection, and the old signed amount can no longer be submitted. authorization.validBefore is the on-chain authorization window and is independent of this 5-minute lock. Both must still be valid at submit time. merchant_name must be the merchant name the user has manually confirmed.

payment_request_id.description: 建单返回的 payment_request_id。 / payment_request_id returned by create_order.

payment_payload.description: 标准 base64 的 x402 v2 JSON。询价时 signature 可为空。accepted 必填 scheme=exact、network=eip155:<chain_id>、asset=合约地址、payTo=收款地址、amount、maxTimeoutSeconds、extra.protocol。eip3009 的 payload 为 {signature, authorization:{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce}}。permit2 的 payload 为 {signature, authorization:{owner,spender,nonce,deadline,permitted:{token,amount}}}。network、asset、payTo 来自 get_order 的 method_data。asset 必须是本次 get_chain_config 的代币 address。payTo 与 to 必须是用户已确认的收款地址。from 与 owner 必须是用户已确认的付款地址。spender 只能是本次 get_chain_config 的 permit2_spender，不能是 verifyingContract、pay_to 或付款地址。用户确认收款地址、付款地址和 token_total_raw 之前不要签名。代币合约和 spender 用本次 get_chain_config 核对，不要让用户手填。accepted.amount 不是最终签名额。 / Standard-base64 x402 v2 JSON. signature may be empty for the quote. accepted requires scheme=exact, network=eip155:<chain_id>, asset=token contract, payTo=recipient, amount, maxTimeoutSeconds, and extra.protocol. eip3009 payload is {signature, authorization:{from,to,value,validAfter,validBefore,nonce}}. permit2 payload is {signature, authorization:{owner,spender,nonce,deadline,permitted:{token,amount}}}. network, asset, and payTo come from get_order method_data. asset must be the token address from this get_chain_config response. payTo and to must be the user-confirmed recipient. from and owner must be the user-confirmed payer. spender must be permit2_spender from this get_chain_config response, not the verifyingContract, pay_to, or the payer address. Do not sign before the user confirms the recipient, the payer address, and token_total_raw. Check the token contract and spender against this get_chain_config response. Do not ask the user to type them. accepted.amount is not the final amount to sign.

merchant_name.description: 必须使用用户已手动确认的商户名称，不得更换。 / Must be the merchant name the user has manually confirmed. Do not substitute another name.

tools.name: finalize_payment
tools.description: 把钱包对 prepare_payment.eip712 的签名写成可提交的 PaymentMandate。传入 signature、prepare_payment 返回的 payment_payload、payment_mandate_contents 和 cart_hash。服务端写入 signature、更新 base64、计算 payment_hash，并用付款地址作为 HMAC 密钥签 HS256 user_authorization。返回的 payment_mandate_json 原样传给 submit_payment。不要自己改报文，不要计算哈希，不要写 Python 或其它脚本。 / Turn the wallet signature of prepare_payment.eip712 into a submittable PaymentMandate. Pass signature and the payment_payload, payment_mandate_contents, and cart_hash returned by prepare_payment. The server writes the signature, refreshes the base64 payload, computes payment_hash, and signs the HS256 user_authorization with the payer address as the HMAC key. Pass the returned payment_mandate_json to submit_payment unchanged. Do not edit the payload, do not compute the hashes, and do not write a Python script or any other script.

signature.description: 钱包对 prepare_payment.eip712 的签名，0x 开头的 65 字节十六进制。 / Wallet signature of prepare_payment.eip712, a 0x-prefixed 65-byte hex string.

payment_payload.description: prepare_payment 返回的 payment_payload，不要改。 / payment_payload returned by prepare_payment. Do not modify it.

payment_mandate_contents.description: prepare_payment 返回的 payment_mandate_contents，不要改。 / payment_mandate_contents returned by prepare_payment. Do not modify it.

cart_hash.description: prepare_payment 返回的 cart_hash。 / cart_hash returned by prepare_payment.

tools.name: get_chain_config
tools.description: 查询 Gateway 当前启用的网络和代币。无业务入参，不需要商户凭证。networks[].name 是网络名称，只用于和 get_order 的 method_data.network、gas_fee_configs[].network 对齐，不写入询价报文。询价报文 accepted.scheme 固定为 exact。accepted.network 用 eip155:<chain_id>，chain_id 取与该订单 method_data.chain_id 相同的 networks[].chain_id。tokens[].payment_protocol 原样写入 accepted.extra.protocol：eip3009 用 authorization 的 from、to、value；permit2 用 owner、spender、permitted，spender 取该代币的 permit2_spender。 / List the networks and tokens currently enabled by the Gateway. No business arguments and no merchant credentials. networks[].name is the network name. Match it to get_order method_data.network and gas_fee_configs[].network. Do not put it in the quote. The quote accepted.scheme is always exact. accepted.network is eip155:<chain_id>, using the networks[].chain_id that matches the order method_data.chain_id. Copy tokens[].payment_protocol into accepted.extra.protocol. eip3009 uses authorization from, to, and value. permit2 uses owner, spender, and permitted, and spender is that token permit2_spender.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: 读取 create_order 创建的同一笔订单，供 Agent 钱包签名前使用。用返回的 flow_id 查询。method_data.chain_id 用来拼询价报文 accepted.network=eip155:<chain_id>。method_data.network 是网络名称，只和 get_chain_config 的 networks[].name 对齐，不写入 accepted.network。accepted.asset 用 method_data.contract_address，accepted.payTo 用 method_data.pay_to。accepted.extra.protocol 用 get_chain_config 里该代币的 payment_protocol。payment_amount 是美元标价，签名金额以 estimate_fee 的 token_total_raw 为准。不需要商户凭证。 / Read the same order created by create_order before the agent wallet signs. Query it with the returned flow_id. Use method_data.chain_id to build the quote accepted.network as eip155:<chain_id>. method_data.network is the network name and only matches get_chain_config networks[].name. Do not put it in accepted.network. accepted.asset is method_data.contract_address and accepted.payTo is method_data.pay_to. accepted.extra.protocol is that token payment_protocol from get_chain_config. payment_amount is the USD price. Sign token_total_raw from estimate_fee. No merchant credentials are required.

flow_id.description: create_order 返回的 flow_id。 / flow_id returned by create_order.

tools.name: prepare_payment
tools.description: 按 flow_id、已确认的付款地址和协议准备待签名数据。protocol 只能是 eip3009 或 permit2。服务端读取订单和链配置、向 Gateway 锁价，并返回 eip712、cart_hash、token_total_raw、quote_expires_at、payment_payload 和 payment_mandate_contents。不要自己拼 x402 JSON，不要写 Python 或其它脚本。签名前向用户展示 pay_to、付款地址和 token_total_raw。用户确认后只签返回的 eip712，不要改 domain 或 message。这里不写入钱包签名，不计算 payment_hash，也不生成 JWT。签完后把签名交给 finalize_payment。锁价 5 分钟，截止时间是 quote_expires_at。 / Prepare the unsigned data for a flow_id, a confirmed payer address, and a protocol. protocol is eip3009 or permit2. The server loads the order and chain config, locks a Gateway quote, and returns eip712, cart_hash, token_total_raw, quote_expires_at, payment_payload, and payment_mandate_contents. Do not assemble the x402 JSON and do not write a Python script or any other script. Before signing, show the user pay_to, the payer address, and token_total_raw. After confirmation, sign only the returned eip712. Do not change its domain or message. This tool does not write the wallet signature, compute payment_hash, or create the JWT. Pass the signature to finalize_payment. The lock lasts 5 minutes. quote_expires_at is the deadline.

flow_id.description: create_order 返回的 flow_id。 / flow_id returned by create_order.

payer.description: 用户已单独确认的付款地址。eip3009 的 from、permit2 的 owner、JWT 的 iss 都用它。不要默认等于 pay_to。 / Payer address the user confirmed on its own. It is the eip3009 from, permit2 owner, and JWT iss. Do not default it to pay_to.

protocol.description: eip3009 或 permit2，必须与订单中该代币的 payment_protocol 一致。 / eip3009 or permit2. It must match that token payment_protocol on the order.

tools.name: query_payment
tools.description: 查询支付状态，并读回 CartMandate 中的 merchant_name。expected_merchant_name 必须是用户已手动确认的商户名称；与落库值不一致时 attribution_verified 为 false。status：payment-required 尚未收到付款；payment-submitted 付款报文已接收；payment-verified 报文已验证；payment-processing 已广播，等待链上确认；payment-timeout 确认超时，仍可恢复并进入延迟对账；payment-included 已进块，等待安全确认；payment-safe 已达到安全确认块数；payment-finalized 最终确认，不可逆；payment-failed 支付失败。 / Query payment status and read merchant_name back from the CartMandate. expected_merchant_name must be the merchant name the user has manually confirmed. attribution_verified is false when it does not match the stored value. status: payment-required means no payment has been received; payment-submitted means the payload was accepted; payment-verified means the payload was verified; payment-processing means it was broadcast and is waiting for chain confirmation; payment-timeout means confirmation timed out but can still recover through delayed reconciliation; payment-included means it is in a block and waiting for safe confirmation; payment-safe means it reached the safe confirmation depth; payment-finalized means finality is confirmed and the transaction is irreversible; payment-failed means the payment failed.

payment_request_id.description: 与 flow_id 二选一。 / Provide this or flow_id.

flow_id.description: 与 payment_request_id 二选一。 / Provide this or payment_request_id.

expected_merchant_name.description: 必须使用用户已手动确认的商户名称，用于和落库 merchant_name 核对。 / Must be the merchant name the user has manually confirmed, compared with the stored merchant_name.

tools.name: submit_payment
tools.description: 提交 finalize_payment 返回的 payment_mandate_json，不要自己把签名写入报文或组装 JWT。payment_mandate_json 是完整请求 JSON，不是再包一层字符串转义。结构：{"payment_mandate":{"payment_mandate_contents":{...},"user_authorization":"<JWT>"}}。payment_mandate_id 和 payment_response.request_id 都等于 create_order 的 payment_request_id。payment_details_id 由调用方新生成且全局唯一。payment_details_total.amount.currency 为 USD；该网络 gas_fee_advanced 为 true 时 value 等于 estimate_fee.token_usd，为 false 时等于 token_usd 加 gas_fee。payment_response.method_name 为 https://www.x402.org。details.payment_payload 是标准 base64 的已签名 x402 v2 JSON，结构与 estimate_fee 相同，但 signature 必须已填，eip3009 的 value 或 permit2 的 permitted.amount 必须等于 token_total_raw，payTo 等于 method_data.pay_to。merchant_agent 为非空付款 Agent 标识。timestamp 为当前 UTC 的 RFC3339。user_authorization 是 HS256 JWT，HMAC 密钥就是 iss 字符串。iss 为用户已确认的付款地址，必须等于 eip3009 的 authorization.from 或 permit2 的 authorization.owner，不得默认写成 pay_to，也不得照抄说明中的地址。claims 含 exp，以及 transaction_data：[cart_hash, payment_hash]。cart_hash 是 get_order.cartmandate.contents 的规范 JSON SHA-256 hex。payment_hash 是本次 payment_mandate_contents 的规范 JSON SHA-256 hex。规范 JSON 按对象键字母序序列化。服务端原样转发，不用商户私钥重签。提交必须早于 estimate_fee 的 quote_expires_at。锁价超过 5 分钟，或 network、asset、payTo 与锁价不一致时，Gateway 返回 code 30043，需要重新锁价并用新的 token_total_raw 重签。 / Submit the payment_mandate_json returned by finalize_payment. Do not write the signature into the payload or assemble the JWT yourself. payment_mandate_json is the complete request JSON, not an extra escaped string. Shape: {"payment_mandate":{"payment_mandate_contents":{...},"user_authorization":"<JWT>"}}. payment_mandate_id and payment_response.request_id both equal the payment_request_id from create_order. payment_details_id is a new globally unique id from the caller. payment_details_total.amount.currency is USD. When gas_fee_advanced is true for that network, value equals estimate_fee.token_usd. When it is false, value equals token_usd plus gas_fee. payment_response.method_name is https://www.x402.org. details.payment_payload is the standard-base64 signed x402 v2 JSON.
